items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: That's where that happened with Papa Celestan in Risley... That's about who the saxes were with Celestan. Yeah, about Papa Celestan. So it's Papa Celestan grabbing. So that's where I settled down. And then we goes on, straightened our band.

ctx.x: With Risley? Well, with both of the bands, you might tell. Oh yeah. So Pete, uh, Teo, Lorenzo Teo was playing

out of Jack Sheen, like I told you. Yeah. With Risley. See? And then they left there. See? And Teo still stuck with Risley until things got good. Then he went, jumped over to Pete Ron again. Then he went to New York. And that's where he went to New York and he never did come back. Stay there. He died there. His wife there, Pete's sister, she played bass too. So that's why. So that's where that happened with Papa Celestan in Risley. Well, did Teo's wife play bass? Sure. I never knew that. That's Peter Burkard's…
players in that band, Bill? Who was that? Did you have any saxophone players? Saxophone players? Saxophone, sure.
